compliance.summary: The GoGloby section and CTA sell AI implementation, rollout, and related tooling rather than the company’s staffing and recruiting services. Decide whether to remove or reposition that offer before retaining the page’s GoGloby claims.

llm_problems.title: AI implementation positioning
llm_problems.rule: decisions.md: Company description; Fact Sheet: Services; Glossary §7
llm_problems.issue: The page presents GoGloby as an AI engineering and adoption provider that implements security workflows and offers an AI rollout, not as a staffing and recruiting agency.
llm_problems.fix: Remove or reposition the AI implementation offer and describe GoGloby only through its approved recruiting and staffing services.
llm_problems.subject: GoGloby positioning and offer
llm_problems.source_value: Staffing and recruiting Data & AI Engineers

locations.quote: engineering standard behind 4x Applied AI Engineering.
locations.reason: This describes GoGloby through an old Applied AI Engineering offer rather than its staffing and recruiting services.

locations.quote: GoGloby approaches AI adoption as an engineering systems problem rather than a tooling decision.
locations.reason: This frames GoGloby as an AI adoption provider instead of a staffing and recruiting agency.

locations.quote: GoGloby embeds senior AI-native engineers directly into SOC and AppSec teams.
locations.reason: This presents a specialized SOC and AppSec engineering offer rather than the documented Data & AI staffing service.

locations.quote: These engineers implement AI-assisted workflows inside defined production queues with named owners and measurable KPIs.
locations.reason: This promises implementation work for clients, while GoGloby’s documented offer is to recruit or staff engineers.

locations.quote: AI usage follows a standardized workflow.
locations.reason: This presents a GoGloby workflow product or method as part of an AI implementation offer, not as a recruiting or staffing service.

locations.quote: All AI-assisted work operates inside a controlled environment with defined access boundaries.
locations.reason: This sells a controlled AI work environment rather than describing the documented staffing service.

locations.quote: performance is continuously measured through the Performance Center.
locations.reason: This presents an old product name as part of the AI implementation offer instead of using the documented AI Development Intelligence Layer.

locations.quote: GoGloby provides governed execution rather than unmanaged acceleration.
locations.reason: This sells governed engineering execution, which is not one of GoGloby’s documented services.

locations.quote: A private AI environment can reduce exposure.
locations.reason: This promotes a private AI environment as an offer that is not listed among GoGloby’s services.

locations.quote: GoGloby can help plan and run an AI rollout that stays measurable and governed.
locations.reason: This promises AI rollout planning and execution rather than recruiting or staffing engineers.
